purpose: Additional official state public-health source for the 1600-versus-1900 North Main address discrepancy.

source.title: First New Mexico measles case of 2025 confirmed in Lea County
source.observation: The state alert identifies Nor-Lea Hospital Emergency Department at 1600 Main Street, Lovington, New Mexico, as an exposure location on February 9, 2025.
source.scope_limit: This is an official public-health exposure notice identifying the emergency-department address on a dated occasion; it is not a hospital licensing record, CMS CCN mapping, or explanation of the current MRF's 1900 North Main field.

finding: Newly retained official state source-instance corroboration places Nor-Lea Hospital's emergency department at 1600 Main Street in 2025. It adds dated public-health evidence for the hospital's 1600 address, but neither establishes whether a distinct hospital site at 1900 exists nor explains the MRF address field.
next_action: Keep CCN 321305 unresolved. Obtain a publisher correction or an authoritative current facility/licensure record tying the hospital and exact MRF location to 1900 North Main; retain the MRF literal/hash and do not normalize it to 1600.
